desc: Ideation: confirm algorithm correctness and formula.
Parse input (N, X, arrays A, B, P, Q).
Trace the P-cycle from X backwards to get `p_path` (0-indexed distances).
Trace the Q-cycle from X backwards to get `q_path`.
Validate that every red ball position is in p_cycle and every blue ball position in q_cycle; else print -1.
Compute `r_max` = max distance in p_path for nodes with A_i=1; `b_max` similarly.
Answer = r_max + b_max - |R_set ∩ B_set| (use a set for intersection).
Print answer; handle edge case r_max=b_max=0 -> answer 0.
